title: Memory Access Out Of Bounds On Web Export (Release Builds)
key_points: The issue is reproducible in Godot 4.6 stable but not in Godot 4.5.1 stable.
Two projects were upgraded from Godot 4.5.1 to Godot 4.6, and both experienced the memory access out of bounds error upon web export.
The issue does not occur when creating a new project with Godot 4.6 and exporting it for the web.
The problem was discovered after upgrading two separate projects from Godot 4.5.1 to Godot 4.6, resulting in failed web exports on Itch.io due to memory access out of bounds errors.
limitations: The issue is specific to the upgrade from Godot 4.5.1 to 4.6.
It only affects web exports and has no impact on other export targets.
asserts: Upgrading projects from Godot 4.5.1 to 4.6 can cause memory access out of bounds errors during web export.
scope: The scope is limited to the specific case of upgrading projects from Godot 4.5.1 to 4.6 and experiencing web export issues due to memory access out of bounds errors.
